notes: 本条目以家用自动电饭煲的商品化为时间轴起点。电热煮饭器早于 1955 年存在，不能将该年当作所有电饭煲的首次发明年份。
notes_en: The timeline starts with commercialization of automatic household rice cookers. Nonautomatic electric rice-cooking devices predate 1955.
summary_zh: 1955 年东芝推出自动电饭煲，将煮饭后的断电控制交给器具；这类产品随后进入日本家庭。它代表自动化的重要节点，早期非自动电热煮饭器则更早出现。
summary_en: Toshiba launched its automatic rice cooker in 1955. Automatic shutoff reduced supervision, and such cookers spread through Japanese homes; nonautomatic electric rice cookers were earlier.
